activationCriteria: Active need for occasional orientation, initiation or communication cueing.
doesNotActivateFrom: Dementia diagnosis, residence in a memory setting, or LOC alone.
caregiverInstruction: Use familiar greeting, one-step cue and preferred communication; allow response time.
escalationTrigger: Acute confusion, new communication loss or marked decline.
reviewStopRule: Review with change in cognition/function and at care-plan review.

activationCriteria: Active need for regular cueing, simple choices and predictable sequence.
doesNotActivateFrom: Diagnosis/history alone or a specific LOC.
caregiverInstruction: Use same sequence, simple choices, visual/verbal cue and calm pace.
shiftTrigger: Morning, meals, evening or other approved transitions
escalationTrigger: New inability to follow familiar sequence or acute change.
reviewStopRule: Review effectiveness and reduce/increase intensity only after reassessment.

activationCriteria: Active frequent redirection, behavior triggers or safety-supervision need.
doesNotActivateFrom: Memory-care label without active assessed staff action.
caregiverInstruction: Identify trigger/unmet need; use approved de-escalation/redirection; document response.
shiftTrigger: When distress, exit-seeking or unsafe action observed
escalationTrigger: Immediate danger uses the emergency pathway; sudden change, injury or failed approach requires nurse review.
reviewStopRule: Nurse reviews pattern, causes and plan after threshold or material change.

activationCriteria: Pervasive cognitive support plus close safety supervision documented as active need.
doesNotActivateFrom: LOC 4/5 or dementia diagnosis alone.
caregiverInstruction: Maintain approved observation intensity and proactive needs support using least-restrictive methods.
escalationTrigger: Missing resident, immediate harm risk, sudden neurological/behavioral change.
reviewStopRule: Frequent nurse review; stop or reduce only through approved reassessment.

activationCriteria: Current fall risk requires staff precautions or assistance.
doesNotActivateFrom: Remote fall history without current assessed action.
caregiverInstruction: Use approved assistance, device, footwear and environment precautions.
escalationTrigger: Fall, near-fall, dizziness, buckling or new assistance need.
reviewStopRule: Reassess after fall/near-fall or functional change.

activationCriteria: Current swallow assessment/order requires staff action.
doesNotActivateFrom: Diagnosis/history without a current diet/swallow plan.
caregiverInstruction: Position, pace and provide only ordered texture/consistency; observe swallow signs.
escalationTrigger: Choking, respiratory distress or new/worsening swallow sign.
reviewStopRule: At order change, swallow reassessment or clinical change.

activationCriteria: Current order requires glucose reading and/or meal-medication coordination.
doesNotActivateFrom: Diabetes diagnosis alone.
caregiverInstruction: Obtain reading using approved technique and report per resident-specific parameters.
requiredResult: Value with units; symptoms; actual time
escalationTrigger: Value outside resident-specific parameter or acute symptoms.
reviewStopRule: Stop/change only by authorized order.

activationCriteria: Current order requires BP/pulse monitoring.
doesNotActivateFrom: Hypertension diagnosis alone.
caregiverInstruction: Measure using approved technique and report per resident-specific parameters.
escalationTrigger: Result outside resident-specific parameter or acute symptoms.
reviewStopRule: Stop/change only by authorized order.

activationCriteria: Assessed fluid-management need and current order/plan.
doesNotActivateFrom: CKD diagnosis without active restriction/target.
caregiverInstruction: Offer and record fluids within the current resident-specific target/restriction.
escalationTrigger: Breathing change, edema, acute decline or parameter breach.
reviewStopRule: Review at order change, weight/condition change or plan review.

activationCriteria: Documented temporary decline or post-hospital support plan.
doesNotActivateFrom: Hospital history after temporary need has resolved.
caregiverInstruction: Use approved temporary assistance and tolerance/rest plan.
escalationTrigger: Further decline, new symptom or inability to complete safely.
reviewStopRule: Mandatory stop/review date; reassess before continuation.

activationCriteria: Current assessed intake/weight concern requiring staff action.
doesNotActivateFrom: Historic low weight without current plan.
caregiverInstruction: Provide approved meal support and record resident-specific intake result.
escalationTrigger: Below resident threshold, continued loss or swallowing concern.
reviewStopRule: Review trend and care plan at specified interval.

activationCriteria: Current continence pattern or urinary concern requires staff action.
doesNotActivateFrom: Diagnosis/history without active support need.
caregiverInstruction: Follow approved toileting pattern; record output and new urinary/skin findings.
escalationTrigger: Fever, pain, blood, retention, acute confusion or reduced output.
reviewStopRule: Review pattern after change or at care-plan review.

activationCriteria: Current one-sided weakness or communication impact requires adapted care.
doesNotActivateFrom: Remote stroke without current staff action.
caregiverInstruction: Use approved side, sequence, device and communication approach.
escalationTrigger: New weakness, facial droop, speech change or acute decline.
reviewStopRule: Review after any functional/neurological change.

activationCriteria: Current motor/timing need affects ADLs, mobility, meals or medication routine.
doesNotActivateFrom: Diagnosis without current functional impact.
caregiverInstruction: Allow initiation time; use approved cueing and movement technique.
escalationTrigger: Sudden mobility change, repeated freezing/fall or swallowing concern.
reviewStopRule: Review with medication or functional change.

activationCriteria: Current hearing need changes how staff must communicate.
doesNotActivateFrom: Hearing diagnosis if communication is effective without staff action.
caregiverInstruction: Face resident, reduce noise, use device/method and confirm understanding.
escalationTrigger: Sudden hearing loss, pain or device failure affecting safety.
reviewStopRule: Review after device or communication change.

activationCriteria: Current visual need requires environmental or task adaptation.
doesNotActivateFrom: Diagnosis without current staff action.
caregiverInstruction: Announce presence, describe setup and keep approved environment consistent.
escalationTrigger: Sudden vision change, collision, fall or new safety risk.
reviewStopRule: Review after visual or safety change.

activationCriteria: Current skin risk, wound or pressure-management plan requires staff action.
doesNotActivateFrom: Risk label without an active assessed intervention.
careEvent: Skin observation or ordered wound care
caregiverInstruction: Observe approved sites; perform treatment only if ordered and within scope.
escalationTrigger: New breakdown, drainage, infection sign, pain or deterioration.
reviewStopRule: Review at wound/skin reassessment and order change.

activationCriteria: Current distress pattern requires an approved nonpharmacologic response.
doesNotActivateFrom: Diagnosis without current behavior/support need.
caregiverInstruction: Check unmet need; use approved reassurance, environment and de-escalation approach.
escalationTrigger: Immediate danger, sudden change, pain/illness sign or failed approach.
reviewStopRule: Nurse reviews repeated pattern and possible clinical causes.

activationCriteria: Current evening/night pattern requires staff action.
doesNotActivateFrom: Prior sleep issue without current assessed need.
caregiverInstruction: Use approved low-stimulation routine, reassurance and safety approach.
requiredResult: Approach; sleep state; response; safety concern
escalationTrigger: Acute confusion, repeated unsafe waking, pain or respiratory concern.
reviewStopRule: Review sleep pattern, effectiveness and continued need.

activationCriteria: Current pain/comfort need requires observation or approved intervention.
doesNotActivateFrom: Pain history without current active need.
caregiverInstruction: Assess observable/self-reported discomfort and provide approved non-drug measure.
escalationTrigger: Severe/new pain, injury, chest pain or failed intervention.
reviewStopRule: Review recurring findings and update plan as indicated.
